prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: two transparent full-body 2D game sprites.
Create the same adult female King Down Archer in exactly the same firing-ready pose twice, side by side: ivory army on the left, charcoal army on the right. Wide 1536x1024 canvas; each complete figure fits comfortably in its own half, with generous transparent margins, aligned foot baseline and equal head/body size.

Reference image 1 (original Archer): character identity and WRIST CROSSBOW design. She has a copper braid, angular adult face, pointed hood, long split robe and leather bracers. The small crossbow is STRAPPED TO HER FOREARM, not held as a conventional bow.
Reference image 2 (earlier painted sprite sheet): crisp hand-painted fantasy illustration style, robe layering and army colours ONLY. Discard every handheld longbow and string-drawing pose from this reference.

Pose: standing in a grounded modest staggered stance, three-quarter view, aiming toward the viewer's right. Her shooting arm extends toward the right at just below shoulder height, with a slight natural elbow bend and straight neutral wrist. A compact wrist-mounted crossbow sits securely on the TOP of the forearm/bracer, its short bolt pointing forward beyond her small loosely closed hand. The short transverse bow limbs and taut string belong entirely to that small mechanical wrist device. Her other arm hangs naturally beside the body, elbow near waist level and hand beside upper thigh. No hand drawing a string, no arm raised behind the head.

ANATOMY IS THE PRIORITY: a coherent single human figure, normal adult proportions about seven heads tall, normal short neck, relaxed shoulders. Upper arm and forearm have believable similar lengths, forearm slightly shorter; shoulder-to-wrist total approximately two head lengths. Correctly placed elbows, modest anatomical hands and clearly connected shoulders/wrists. No rubber arms, extra joints, tiny upper arms, elongated forearms or oversized hands. Both variants have the identical anatomy, pose and weapon placement.

Costume: dominant warm ivory on left hood, fitted practical bodice and robe; dominant charcoal/slate on corresponding right garments. Narrow brown belts/bracers/boots only, small olive-green hood lining and wrist-bow jewel, copper braid. Rich but restrained painted modelling and confident edges, faithful to the 2D fantasy reference. Full boots and complete robe hems visible, no bases or chopped-off bottoms. The weapon is compact and cleanly readable, not an oversized mechanical contraption.

Genuinely transparent alpha background, opaque figures, clear empty space between them. No background colour, vignette, atmospheric haze, checkerboard, text, labels, borders, scenery, ground shadow or glow cloud. NOT a 3D render. NOT a character made from disconnected cutout limbs.
